description: Sixty-three records of five graphics/palette visual variants selected by record ID and variant; historical menu-ui slug retained for compatibility.
verification_method: 0x08096138 returns 0x085A4DEC + record_id*40 + variant*8 for variants 0..4; variant 5 returns the special pair at 0x085A4DE4. This closes 63 records ending at 0x5A57C4.
notes: The old bank flattened records 61 and 62. Record 0 is an intentional all-zero record; nonzero gfx targets are LZ77 and companion targets are RGB555-shaped palettes. Legacy rows remain diagnostic-only.
